verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents official drivers and APIs for several languages, lists DuckDB SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java as connection paths, and ships its own Wasm Client library for browser applications. missing for 10: in-depth per-language SDK reference documentation, clarity on which SDKs are MotherDuck-specific rather than generic DuckDB SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Connect to MotherDuck using official drivers and APIs for various programming languages.
DuckDB SDKs: Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java
The MotherDuck Wasm Client library enables using MotherDuck through DuckDB Wasm in your own browser applications.
